pl.w013: Ad z audiéndam wyraża cel: „aby słuchać”. Audiéndam zgadza się z vocem, które jest biernikiem liczby pojedynczej rodzaju żeńskiego.
pl.w026: Łacińskie ómnia i quæ są w liczbie mnogiej, stąd sunt. Polskie „wszystko, co” łączy się tutaj z liczbą pojedynczą: „jest”.
pl.w062: Ad z audiéndam wyraża cel: „aby słuchać”. Audiéndam zgadza się z vocem, które jest biernikiem liczby pojedynczej rodzaju żeńskiego.

en.w013: Ad with audiéndam expresses purpose: “to hear.” Audiéndam agrees with vocem in the feminine accusative singular.
en.w020: Bénedic takes Dómino in the Latin dative. English “bless” takes a direct object here: “the Lord.”
en.w026: Ómnia and quæ are plural in Latin, so the verb is sunt. English “all that” takes singular “is” in this collective reading.
en.w027: Nómini is the dative complement of the understood command to bless, parallel to Dómino. English uses “His holy name” as the direct object.

method: Transcribed from the directly viewed page image of the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam with declared common-formula expansions and a declared correction of printed sermónem to sermónum. The witness header identifies the printed reading and expansion sources, including the Ordo colon after semper. Adjudicated accent and orthographic differences are recorded in the apparatus.
apparatus_note: The twelve adjudicated entries record accent and house-orthography differences. The MR witness header separately declares the proper page’s printed sermónem corrected to sermónum at w015. This is a printing-slip corrigendum, not an alternate spelling or a new adjudicated reading. The proper page prints only Gloria Patri and reprise cues. Its supplied doxology uses the house comma after semper at w044, while the Ordo source on printed p. 219 has semper:. The repeated antiphon is a house expansion under RG 427, not independent corroboration of the correction. The declared corrigendum and expansion punctuation remain distinct from these twelve adjudicated entries.

about.pl: Introitus formularza „Poświęcenie Bazyliki św. Michała Archanioła” w Mszale Rzymskim z 1962 roku.
about.en: The introitus of the formulary “Dedication of Saint Michael the Archangel” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

prose.pl: Błogosławcie Pana, wszyscy Jego aniołowie, potężni mocą, którzy wypełniacie Jego słowo, aby słuchać głosu Jego słów. Błogosław, duszo moja, Panu, i wszystko, co we mnie jest, Jego świętemu imieniu. Chwała Ojcu i Synowi, i Duchowi Świętemu. Jak była na początku, teraz i zawsze, i na wieki wieków. Amen. Błogosławcie Pana, wszyscy Jego aniołowie, potężni mocą, którzy wypełniacie Jego słowo, aby słuchać głosu Jego słów.
prose.en: Bless the Lord, all His angels, you mighty in strength, who carry out His command, listening to the voice of His words. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless His holy name. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Bless the Lord, all His angels, you mighty in strength, who carry out His command, listening to the voice of His words.

This edition accents capitals, by the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md, because the accent tells a reader where the stress falls and a capital does not stop being a syllable. Most printings omit them; the reading is identical.

The mid-century hand missals print j; neither spelling is a different word, and the apparatus records theirs.
